nodes.name: Search input
nodes.notes: Edit one topic and an explicit publication-date window. The before date is exclusive. Plan freshness and date-window limits apply.

nodes.name: Search Arcmira
nodes.notes: Choose your own HTTP Bearer Auth credential. Token placeholder: YOUR_ARCMIRA_API_KEY. Never paste the token into workflow fields. One GET /v1/search request, fixed limit 3, no pagination or transcript retrieval. Errors stop the workflow.

parameters.jsCode:
const response = $input.first().json;
const requested = $('Search input').first().json;
if (!Array.isArray(response.chunks)) throw new Error('Expected a search response with chunks. Inspect the HTTP Request error or response.');
if (response.chunks.length > 3) throw new Error('Unexpected result count above the configured three-passage limit.');
return [{ json: {
  query: response.query,
  requested_window: { after: requested.after, before: requested.before },
  applied_window: response.window,
  returned: response.returned,
  partial: response.partial ?? false,
  failed_batches: response.failed_batches ?? 0,
  as_of: response.as_of,
  search_index: response.search_index,
  note: response.note,
  access: response.access ?? null,
  unlock: response.unlock ?? null,
  candidates: response.chunks.map((c, index) => ({
    ordinal: index + 1,
    video_id: c.video_id,
    title: c.video_title ?? null,
    channel: c.channel_name ?? null,
    published_at: c.published_at,
    passage: c.text,
    passage_start_seconds: c.start_seconds,
    source_watch_url: c.watch_url,
    arcmira_url: c.watch_url.startsWith('/') ? 'https://arcmira.com' + c.watch_url : c.watch_url,
    original_source_url: 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' + encodeURIComponent(c.video_id)
      + (c.start_seconds === null ? '' : '&t=' + c.start_seconds + 's'),
    transcript_source: c.source,
    transcript_source_label: c.source_label ?? null,
    speaker_names: c.speakers ?? [],
    speaker_entities: c.speakers_by ?? [],
    cut_start_seconds: null,
    cut_end_seconds: null,
    playback_verified: false,
    speaker_identity_verified: false,
    reuse_permission: 'not established',
    selection: 'unselected candidate'
  }))
} }];

nodes.name: Build source shortlist
nodes.notes: Candidate passages only. Preserve applied window, source provenance and coverage notes. Review playback, identity and cut boundaries before editing.
